newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba, Chartered Semiconductor agree DRAM tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba, Chartered Semiconductor agree DRAM tie-up.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Tuesday that it has agreed on a tie-up in embedded dynamic random access memories (DRAMs) with Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing.
Under the agreement, Toshiba will license its embedded DRAM technology to Chartered Semiconductor. The Singaporean company will then manufacture DRAM products for Toshiba and other customers.
The tie-up allows Chartered to enter the fast-growing market for embedded DRAMs, while Toshiba gains a secure source of the products, Toshiba said in a statement.
Possible applications for embedded DRAMs, which integrate traditional DRAMs with digital logic on a single chip, include handheld computer devices that require low power consumption.
Chartered Semiconductor is a unit of government-owned Singapore Technologies.
